reasons: Position LTV 0.3825 is far below the corridor act level 0.7 and the 0.86 liquidation LTV; a 55.52% collateral price drop would be needed to liquidate.
The only fired screen on this market is marginal: ETH/USD feed age 1201 s vs max 1200 s (1 s over); the pool price equals the oracle price (0.0% divergence), cross-checking the stale feed.
Market conditions are calm: utilization 0.5946 is below the 0.95 screen threshold, borrow APR is 0.58%, and loan-token liquidity is available.

Text feeds show no critical risk: the Base Denim upgrade is scheduled for Nov 5 18:00 UTC (still ahead) with mainnet expected operational, prior incidents are resolved, and venue status reports no open oracle or pool incidents; no basis for reduce_light, reduce_to_target, or leave_market.
Selling collateral now is unwarranted: LTV is already below the 0.5 target, and a 1-second feed staleness with matching pool/oracle prices does not change position risk.

items.title: Testnet markets operating normally
items.text: Testnet markets operating normally | The live, backup and demo markets on Base Sepolia (deployments/testnet.json) accept supply and borrowing. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.

items.title: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed
items.text: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed | On 4 November the team's lender supply returned to the live and backup markets (13 USDC each) and the demo market (5,000 dUSDC) on Base Sepolia, and the executor moved to 0xA9bbabE6d75C5BA96CA095586284774c9D09D18b (deployments/testnet.json). All three markets accept supply and borrowing; the live market's public Uniswap 0.01% pool again holds the team's price band. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.
